answer.answer: The honest MVP remains a versioned, local-first native iPhone Watch Session built around Mission Timeline. It shows the next meaningful event—not merely elapsed cycle time—while treating gathering opportunities as independent evidence-bearing windows. Exactness, install readiness, and unvalidated game transitions must not be overstated.

claims.value: The design boundary is Early Access Update 1 through Hotfix `0.2.8`, Steam build `23761620`, released 2026-06-17, with SRDB `2.3.4` captured 2026-07-11 and a 54-minute community/game-data cycle measured from local fire-wave impact to the next impact. The implemented r1 definition is `ruptura-cycle/u1-srdb-2.3.4/r1`, snapshot `ea-u1-gv35118973__srdb-2.3.4__20260711T050230Z`, source-claimed build `ea_u1_0.2.0_build_22674441`, latest-public-build-at-capture `ea_u1_0.2.8_build_23761620`, captured `2026-07-11T05:02:30.009644Z`. Creepy Jar has not published an official numerical phase formula, so transitions remain versioned predictions; use `predicted`, `expected`, `favorable`, and `lower threat`, never `exact`, `safe`, or `guaranteed`. Confidence states are `Unsynced`, `Manual sync - predicted`, `Confirmed at one later transition`, `Drift suspected`, and `Cycle data changed - re-sync required`; downgrade after large correction, device-clock or model-version change, uncertain pause, save/reload, or server stop. Historical evidence records no final handoff or proof that simulator/install-ready acceptance passed.

Its player-facing 54-minute sequence is Fire wave `0:00-0:30` (`Remain sheltered`), Cooling `0:30-1:30` (`Remain sheltered`), Recovery/quiet window `1:30-11:30` (`Lower ambient risk; triggered encounters may persist`), World active `11:30-51:30` (`Ordinary hostiles expected`), and Ruptura warning `51:30-54:00` (`Return, bank loot, and shelter`). The portrait hierarchy, all visible without scrolling, is: sync/capability line; semantic hero state with huge monospaced countdown and explicit target; threat instruction plus one action sentence; at most two opportunity cards; then exact-time next events with only `Mute one cycle` and `Re-sync` always visible. The hero counts down to the next meaningful event: expected ordinary Vermin return during recovery, warning start during the active world, and Ruptura impact during warning; the whole-cycle proportional rail is orientation only, supplemented by minimum-width labels or next events so short dangerous phases remain legible.

claims.value: Opportunities are independent versioned evidence records, not consequences baked into phase mechanics. Each `OpportunityWindow` carries an ID, start/end event or offset, action, caveat, evidence class, confidence, applicable game build, and source snapshot. MVP displays at most two prioritized cards with visible provenance. Candidate windows include lower ambient POI threat with triggered/scripted encounters still possible; Oxallop while lakebeds are dry; favorable cave access for Quartz and Glowcaps without guaranteed respawn; variable post-wave Ignitium and egg opportunities; experimental late-recovery Star Tears, including the choice to leave cooled Ignitium; and surface regrowth without species-specific timing guarantees. Sulheart stays hidden until exact timing is validated. Enemy-return events and gathering windows must remain separate versioned facts even when their current timing aligns with phase boundaries.

claims.value: Enemy-return and Ruptura alerts require distinct sounds and haptics and must never depend on color or audio alone. Enemy-return escalation is 5 minutes, 2 minutes, 1 minute, 15 seconds, then event; Ruptura supports optional 10 minutes, then 5 minutes, 2:30 warning start, 1 minute, 30 seconds, 15 seconds, and impact. Profiles are `Full`, `Haptic only`, and `Visual only`, with separate phase/enemy/Ruptura/opportunity toggles, `Mute one cycle`, previews, and an adjustable exit buffer; after resume, collapse missed cues into the strongest current message rather than replaying a backlog. Native behavior schedules local notifications at absolute dates, recomputes from `(now - anchor) modulo cycle duration` on resume, reschedules after anchor/model/policy changes, and deduplicates by cycle number plus event ID. Disable the idle timer only while the monitor scene is active and restore it afterward; never use background audio as keep-alive. A Live Activity represents only the currently armed event. AlarmKit may break through Silent mode and Focus only after explicit player arming and authorization—never silently create endless 54-minute alarms; older iOS uses normal notifications, Time Sensitive is opt-in, and Critical Alerts are inappropriate. Accessibility requires text, symbols, border shape and optional patterns alongside color, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, high contrast, Differentiate Without Color and Reduce Motion; avoid flashing transitions, default per-second ticking, and per-second VoiceOver announcements, while keeping `Re-sync`, `Mute one cycle`, capability status, and `Next alert at …` visible.
